description: Returns moonrise, moonset and the Moon's highest point on a local date for a city from the website's list of world cities, or for any latitude and longitude, with compass directions and the Moon's phase that day. Also returns when the Moon is up after dark and, for today, where the Moon is right now. Times are in the place's own time zone.

date.description: Local calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to 2100; today at the place when omitted.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, north positive. Given together with longitude and timeZone for a place outside the city list.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, east positive. Given together with latitude and timeZone.

place.description: A city from the website's list of 136 world cities, such as London, Lima or Perth. Required unless latitude, longitude and timeZone are given.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone name of the place, such as Atlantic/Reykjavik. Needed with latitude and longitude; a city uses its own zone.

name: get_moonrise_moonset
title: Moonrise and moonset
